producer: Institut national de l’information géographique et forestière (IGN)
tile_size: 1 km² tiles; approximately 500 MB–2 GB each (dataset description)
relevant_area: Paris petite couronne, selected in the official viewer
representation: Present-day classified aerial LiDAR point cloud for ground and above-ground objects; regional spatial context, not a facade-textured photogrammetry mesh and not a historical reconstruction.
notes: Use the official streaming viewer instead of downloading huge point-cloud tiles into the website repository. Old Hôtel de Ville geometry remains an evidence-constrained historical reconstruction.
viewer_license: Upstream custom attribution license; LICENSE and NOTICE are vendored. Required clickable credit to https://www.simulateur-toiture.fr remains enabled.

in_app_viewer.renderer: single-tone WebGL points; no textured mesh or classification colors

viewer_provider: Romain Rivière · open-source third-party web viewer; not an IGN-operated site
viewer_access_note: Viewer fallback changed after the legacy IGN viewer host failed DNS/timeout checks in this environment. The official IGN open dataset remains linked separately; direct in-exhibit loading remains the primary experience. The external viewer accepts address search and displays available COPC coverage.
